title: Generation of Human Kidney Tubuloids from Tissue and Urine
markdown:
## Protocol: I want to build an expandable renal epithelial organoid culture from a freshly collected human urine sample, without using a kidney tissue biopsy. Describe sample processing, initial three-dimensional culture, routine maintenance and repeated passaging. Include the culture-handling steps needed to preserve the urine-derived tubuloid line.

### Overview

This protocol outlines the generation and maintenance of an expandable renal epithelial organoid culture derived from freshly collected human urine samples, avoiding the use of kidney tissue biopsies. The process involves specific reagent preparation, careful processing of urine samples to isolate tubuloids, initial plating in basement membrane extract (BME), routine maintenance, and repeated passaging to preserve the urine-derived tubuloid line.

### Materials/Reagents

Advanced DMEM/F12; L-alanine/L-glutamine supplement; 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazine ethanesulfonic acid (HEPES); Penicillin/Streptomycin antibiotics; B27 supplement; R-spondin-conditioned medium; epidermal growth factor (EGF); fibroblast growth factor-10 (FGF10); N-acetylcysteine; Rho-kinase inhibitor Y-27632; broad-spectrum antibiotics; A83-01; Basement Membrane Extract (BME).

### Equipment

Multiwell tissue culture plates (6, 12, and 24 wells); 50 mL tubes; 15 mL tubes; Centrifuge; Horizontal shaker; p1000 and p200 sterile pipettes; 10 mL sterile pipette; Autoclave.

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile conditions throughout all procedures. Use autoclaved non-filtered p10 tips where specified. Keep temperature-sensitive reagents on ice or at 4 °C as indicated. Ensure proper handling of biological samples.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-experiment Setup

1. Prewarm multiwell tissue culture plates (6, 12, and 24 wells) overnight at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Prepare basal medium (AdDF+++) by adding 1x L-alanine/L-glutamine supplement, 1% w/v 4-(2-hydroxyethyl)-1-piperazine ethanesulfonic acid (HEPES, 10 mM), and 1% Penicillin/Streptomycin antibiotics to Advanced DMEM/F12. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Keep the prepared basal medium (AdDF+++) on ice during the procedure. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
3. Prepare culture medium by adding 1.5% B27 supplement, 10% R-spondin-conditioned medium, epidermal growth factor (50 ng/mL), fibroblast growth factor-10 (100 ng/mL), N-acetylcysteine (1.25 mM), Rho-kinase inhibitor Y-27632 (10 µM), broad-spectrum antibiotics (0.1 mg/mL), and A83-01 (5 µM) to AdDF+++. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
4. Warm the culture medium up to 37 °C before use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
5. Prepare washing medium by supplementing AdDF+++ with broad-spectrum antibiotics (0.1 mg/mL) and 10 µM Y-27632. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->
6. Thaw an aliquot of basement membrane extract (BME) overnight at 4 °C, and keep it on ice during the procedure. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S07 -->
7. Prepare a trypsin replacement agent by adding Y-27632 to a concentration of 10 µM, and warm it up to 37 °C before use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S08 -->
8. Autoclave non-filtered p10 tips. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S09 -->
9. Cool the centrifuge to 4 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S10 -->
10. Prewarm a horizontal shaker to 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S11 -->

## Procedure

### Urine Sample Processing - Initial Wash

1. Collect a urine sample and divide it equally into 50 mL tubes. Add 10-20 mL of washing medium to each tube. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Centrifuge the tubes at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and carefully remove the supernatant. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
3. Add 10 mL of washing medium to each tube, and carefully resuspend the pellets using a 10 mL sterile pipette. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
4. Centrifuge again at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and carefully remove the supernatant. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->

### Urine Sample Processing - Pooling and Final Wash

1. Resuspend the pellets and transfer the contents of all tubes into one 15 mL tube. Fill the tube with washing medium. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->
2. Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and remove the supernatant. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S02 -->
3. Measure the volume of the cell pellet using a p1000 pipette set to a known volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S03 -->
4. Carefully pipette up and down to resuspend the pellet without creating air bubbles. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S04 -->
5. Transfer the tube to ice for 1 min. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S05 -->

### Plating Tubuloids

1. Add a volume of BME equivalent to 70-75% of the cell pellet volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->
2. Resuspend the mixture using a p1000 or p200 pipette, and plate 15 µL droplets in a prewarmed multiwell cell culture plate. Select the well size based on total plating volume: <100 µL for 24 wells, 100-200 µL for 12 wells, or >200 µL for 6 wells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S02 -->
3. Turn the plates upside down and let them rest in the incubator for 15-20 min at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S03 -->
4. Add prewarmed culture medium and inspect the cultures. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S04 -->

### Passaging Urine-Derived Cultures

1. Fill the tube with AdDF+++, centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, and remove the supernatant. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S01 -->
2. Measure the volume of the cell pellet using a p1000 pipette set to a known volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S02 -->
3. Carefully pipette up and down to resuspend the pellet without creating air bubbles. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S03 -->
4. Transfer the tube to ice for 1 min. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S04 -->
5. Add a volume of BME equivalent to 70-75% of the cell pellet volume. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S05 -->
6. Resuspend the mixture using a p1000 or p200 pipette, and plate 15 µL droplets in a prewarmed multiwell cell culture plate. Select the well size based on total plating volume: <100 µL for 24 wells, 100-200 µL for 12 wells, or >200 µL for 6 wells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S06 -->
7. Turn the plates upside down and let them rest in the incubator for 15-20 min at 37 °C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S07 -->
8. Add prewarmed culture medium and inspect the cultures. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S08 -->

## References
